items.title: Ethereum Glamsterdam upgrade could slip to May 2027 over compatibility concerns
items.summary: Ethereum developers are weighing gas pricing changes that could disrupt existing smart contracts after contacting at least 50 affected companies.

items.title: Bitcoin price ignores Anthropic debut as ANT share price dips below $100

items.title: Hong Kong adds Hyperliquid to list of suspicious crypto platforms
items.summary: Hong Kong securities regulator said Hyperliquid has no local license and may have promoted trading services in the city.

items.summary: Claude maker began trading under ticker ANT with valuation around $2 trillion at the opening price.

items.summary: Phylax system lets protocols block potentially harmful transactions but raises censorship and builder concentration questions.

items.title: Sweden H100 could tap Bitcoin trading pool to fund share buybacks
items.summary: Shareholders vote Dec. 7 on buybacks potentially using a Bitcoin pool that lost about 30 BTC in Q3.

items.title: Protesters Arrested Outside Nasdaq as Activists Oppose Anthropic IPO Over AI Bubble Risks
items.summary: At least four people arrested outside Nasdaq during Anthropic IPO as protesters warned of AI valuation risks to retirement savers.

items.title: Former Robinhood Engineer Pleads Guilty to Crypto Insider Trading Scheme
items.summary: Huaisong Xiang admitted trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid using confidential Robinhood listing plans.

items.summary: Global securities watchdog said markets should not wait for quantum computers, flagging bulkier signatures and harder upgrades.

items.title: CFTC Chair Selig outlines how Hyperliquid and other onchain venues could enter the US
items.summary: Michael Selig said platforms like Hyperliquid have two ways to enter the U.S. retail market and must follow the same rules as other exchanges.

items.summary: Users can fund a position with a token they already hold on 1inch, which will be routed to USDC and deposited to Hyperliquid.

items.title: Binance obtains $6.5 billion freezing order from Abu Dhabi court

items.summary: Nov. 18 post-mortem explains why wallet signers had to return and how proof submission came back before app access.

items.title: Arthur Hayes predicts 97% crypto rally weeks after he exited trades
items.summary: His targets for ETH, ZEC, NEAR and VVV were 57.8% to 97.3% above their Nov. 18 Coinbase closes.

items.title: CoinShares unloads $19.3M in ETH and SOL, yet keeps crypto risk
items.summary: October sales freed $19.3 million for potential buybacks while fees, lending and trading keep earnings tied to crypto.

items.title: Binance wins $6.5 billion freezing order against hackers behind crypto largest theft
items.summary: Exchange said it has already replaced the stolen assets using its own funds and insurance reserves.

items.title: Trump Media wants to clear $884 million of debt without selling its bitcoin

items.summary: Senate Banking Committee held confirmation hearing for two nominees as administration rebuilds market regulators.

items.summary: Monetary Authority of Singapore issued S$100 million in tokenized bills settled with CBDC.
